new.story: A bronze penny from the reign of George V, showing Britannia with trident and shield on the reverse. Britain's pennies were the workhorse small change of the empire — this one circulated when a penny still bought something.

source: NOID_UnitedKingdom_1922_1Penny_rev.jpg: Britannia reverse, ONE PENNY legend, date 1922 read digit-by-digit (1-9-2-2) from enlargement; no mint mark visible on this side; Phase 1 default value
